arabic text: HAI SAARE AZADAARON KE LAB PER YEHI SADA
english translation text: This is the cry upon every mourner's lips: Abbas, by the sake of Ummul Baneen.

arabic text: HUM JAANTE HAI TERA KARAM HOGAYA AGAR\nAASAAN HOTI JAAEGI HAR EK REH GUZAR\nHO JALD KHATM KARBOBALA SE YE FAASLA
english translation text: We know that if your grace reaches us,\nevery path will become easier.\nMay this distance from Karbala soon come to an end.

arabic text: DARTAY NAHI JO MAUT SE SARWAR KE PYAAR ME\nWHO SAB HAIN APNI MAA(n) KI DUA KE HISAAR ME\nUN KE SARO(n) SE MAAO(n) KA SAAYA NA HO JUDA
english translation text: Those who do not fear death in love for Sarwar\nremain surrounded by their mothers' prayers.\nMay the shade of their mothers never leave their heads.

arabic text: BEEMAR E KARBALA O MADINA KI HAI QASAM\nBEEMAR HAIN JO LOUG KAREIN UN PE AB KARAM\nKHAAKE SHIFA KE SADQE ATA KIJIE SHIFA
english translation text: By the ailing ones of Karbala and Madina,\nshow mercy now to all who are ill.\nFor the sake of the healing dust, grant them healing.

arabic text: JO LAA WALAD HAIN UNKE GHAMO’n KO MITAAYIE\nMOLA UNHEI(n) BHI NANNA AZADAR CHAHIYE\nASGHER KA SADQA UNKO ATA KIJIYE ZARA
english translation text: Remove the grief of those without children.\nMaula, they too desire a little mourner.\nFor Asghar's sake, grant them this gift.

arabic text: JO BHI JAWAA(n) UTHAATA HAI MOLA TERA ALAM\nAKBAR KE SADQE UN KA SALAMAT RAHE BHARAM\nZINDA RAHE(n) JO BEHNO(n) KE DIL KA HAI(n) HOSLA
english translation text: Maula, whoever raises your standard while young—\nfor Akbar's sake, preserve their honour.\nMay those who are the courage of their sisters remain alive.

arabic text: HALAAT KUCH BHI HONGAY QADAM NA HATAEIN GE\nZAINAB KAY OR SAKINA KAY ROZAY PE JAAYEIN GE\nAB JALD KAR DEIN IZN E ZIYARAT HUME ATA
english translation text: Whatever the conditions, we will not step back.\nWe will visit the shrines of Zainab and Sakina.\nGrant us permission for visitation soon.

arabic text: AZLAAN AUR KARIM PE ITNA KARE(n) KARAM\nMEHDI KE SAATH HUM BHI UTHAE(n) TERA ALAM\nJAARI RAHE ATAAO(n) KA HUM PER YE SILSILA
english translation text: Show such grace to Azlaan and Karim\nthat we too may raise your standard beside Mahdi.\nMay this chain of your gifts continue over us.
